description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies , and through our businesses including Trane®  and  Thermo King ,  sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business.  Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities?  Do you want to contribute to making a better future?  If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.
 
 Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home. 
 
 We boldly go.
 
 Where is the work: 
Virtual  
  
 Executive Project Developers combine deep project development expertise with exceptional leadership and problem-solving ability. They serve as trusted resources for regional teams, leading challenging opportunities, evaluating complex technical and financial decisions, communicating effectively with executive stakeholders, and driving alignment across multidisciplinary teams.   

 

 Successful Executive Project Developers understand how customer needs, building systems, financial structures, construction execution, risk management, emerging technologies, and organizational priorities come together to create successful projects. They are comfortable leading workshops, coaching regional developers, reviewing construction strategies, and presenting to executive decision makers. Above all, they elevate everyone around them.   
 

 What you will do:   

 Lead Strategic Project Development   

 
 Oversee project development for high-profile, complex, and strategic opportunities across North America   

 
 Support regional teams throughout opportunity qualification, audit planning, solution development, project strategy, financial evaluation, risk management, customer engagement, and contract execution   

 
 Support Regional Teams & Capability Growth   

 
 Collaborate with Project Developers, Sales teams, Energy Engineers, and Operations leaders to strengthen project development capabilities   

 
 Provide coaching, mentoring, technical guidance, and project leadership support to ensure successful development and execution of complex opportunities   

 
 Drive Project Strategy & Customer Alignment   

 
 Facilitate definition of customer objectives , prioritization of investments, evaluation of alternatives, and alignment of stakeholders around a common vision   

 
 Support executive presentations, customer workshops, and strategic planning discussions throughout project development   

 
 Advance Project Development Excellence   

 
 Promote deployment and adoption of project development standard work, tools, processes, and best practices across North America   

 
 Encourage knowledge sharing, capture lessons learned, and identify opportunities to enhance consistency, quality, productivity, and customer outcomes   

 
 Champion Innovation & Emerging Technologies   

 
 Evaluate market trends, customer needs, and emerging technologies to identify new solution opportunities   

 
 Partner with internal experts to incorporate advanced technologies, building analytics, geothermal, digital solutions, AI-enabled tools, electrification strategies, and resilience-focused solutions into customer projects   

 
 Ensure Technical, Financial & Execution Alignment   

 
 Guide teams in balancing customer objectives , technical feasibility, financial performance, constructability, operational considerations, implementation risk, and long-term value   

 
 Support quality reviews of audits, financial models, project scopes, contractor strategies, and customer deliverables   

 
 What you will bring:   

 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering , Construction Management, Energy Management, Facilities Management, Architecture, Business, or related discipline; or equivalent combination of education and experience   

 
 8+ years of experience leading development of complex energy, infrastructure, facility modernization, design-build, performance contracting, or capital improvement projects   

 
 Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary project development teams through opportunity qualification, audit development, solution development, financial evaluation, and contract execution   

 
 Strong understanding of building systems, energy conservation measures, facility infrastructure, constructability, and project implementation strategies   

 
 Experience developing and evaluating business cases, lifecycle cost analyses, financial models, project risks, and customer value propositions   

 
 Ability to lead and influence diverse teams without direct authority   

 
 Strong communication , facilitation, presentation, and executive engagement skills   

 
 Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with audiences ranging from facility and operational stakeholders to executive leadership   

 
 Experience coordinating engineers, consultants, contractors, estimators, operations teams, and customer stakeholders throughout project development   

 
 Willingness to travel throughout North America to support regional teams and strategic customer opportunities   

 
 Preferred Experience   

 Experience leading Investment Grade Audits (IGA), Detailed Audits, Energy Savings Performance Contracting (ESPC), Design-Build, Large Turnkey, Healthcare, Higher Education, K-12, Municipal, Federal, Industrial, or Commercial projects   

 
 Deep familiarity with HVAC systems, controls, energy management systems, electrical infrastructure, central utility plants, renewable energy systems, resilience solutions, and intelligent building technologies   

 
 Experience managing project development budgets, schedules, audit teams, consultant engagements, and contractor procurement activities   

 
 Experience deploying standard work, operational improvements, capability-building programs, or organizational change initiatives across multiple teams or regions   

 
 Preferred Certifications   

 One or more of the following certifications are valued:   

 Professional Engineer (PE)   

 
 Certified Energy Manager (CEM)   

 
 Project Management Professional (PMP)   

 
 Design-Build Institute of America (DBIA)   

 
 LEED Accredited Professional (LEED AP)   

 
 Certified Commissioning Professional (CCP)   

 
 
 
 Annual Base Salary Range or Hourly Base Pay Range: 
$113,600.00 - $204,609.99 Compensation Type: 
Salary Incentive Eligible: 
Yes Sales Commission Eligible: 
No 
 Disclaimer : We strive to provide competitive compensation for this position, tailored to a variety of factors. The actual compensation will depend on elements such as seniority, merit, geographic location, education, experience,  travel requirements, and union designation.   Our compensation range is generally based on the national average for the country.  Additionally, benefits may vary depending on the region, business alignment, union involvement, and employee status.
 
 Thrive at work and at home: 

 Benefits kick in on DAY ONE for you and your family, including health insurance and holistic wellness programs that include generous incentives – WE DARE TO CARE!
 Family building benefits include fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy assistance.
 401K match up to 6%, plus an additional 2% core contribution = up to 8% company contribution.
 Paid time off includes 15 vacation days, 9 paid holidays, 3 floating holidays, sick leave, and additional options to support volunteer and parental leave.
 Educational and training opportunities through company programs along with tuition assistance and student debt support.
 
 Disclaimer:  Benefit offerings may vary depending on Collective Bargaining Agreements and local/state regulations.

 Safety Sensitive Role: 
Yes The company designates certain roles as Safety Sensitive. Safety Sensitive roles may require that you pass additional drug screening.
 
 We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.
